name: montage
description: Ingest videos into Montage and turn them into editable moments, via the Montage MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Ingest videos and cut them into shareable moments
interface.longDescription: Ingest a video into Montage from a Google Drive or public URL, follow the pipeline through transcription and analysis, then pick segments and create editable moments with a link back to the Montage editor.
defaultPrompt: Ingest this video into Montage and tell me when it is ready.
Find the best 60 seconds of this video and make a moment from it.
